why: #721 moves actions/setup-python from v3 to v6 in go.yml, which runs on PR CI. v6 has no default python-version (v3 had 3.x), so CI uses the runner's Python. On 2026-10-06 the verifier blocked it because the PR removes an actionlint finding, and it asked about workflows that PR CI does not run. It must ask only about the changed default.
